en.name: Yuanzhi Xu
bio: I am a master’s student in Environmental Science and Engineering at Guangxi Normal University. My current work explores machine learning for drinking-water treatment, with an emphasis on prediction and model interpretation.
My undergraduate work at Taiyuan University focused on computer vision, robotic manipulation, and AI-assisted diagnosis. I document the research, systems, and experiences that shape my work here.
en.description: Academic research and personal milestones in machine learning for environmental science, computer vision, and robotics.

zh.name: 许源知
zh.role: 硕士研究生 · 环境科学与工程
bio: 我目前在广西师范大学攻读环境科学与工程硕士，关注机器学习在饮用水处理中的应用，重点包括预测建模与模型解释。
本科就读于太原学院物联网工程专业，围绕计算机视觉、机器人操作与人工智能辅助诊断开展科研和工程实践。这里记录我的研究、项目与成长经历。
zh.description: 个人学术主页，记录机器学习与环境科学、计算机视觉、机器人方向的研究、项目与成长经历。
